title: Povo campus reconstruction route
status: Design after user acceptance of outdoor gameplay; not new playable geometry

baseline.scope: User accepted the requested outdoor buy, movement, radar, objective and round checks; no independent-client test was reported.

finish_priority: red stair treads and dark nosings
white corridor walls and glazed courtyard
classroom wood floor, continuous desk rows and rear glazing
first_reconstruction.gate: Walk from the real entrance through the southeast stair to A215, traverse the floor-1 corridor loop, and return without noclip or teleportation.
constraints: Replace overlapping Povo 1 solid massing with a hollow shell before integration.
Match exterior windows to actual interior openings; do not stack opaque facade glazing across playable windows.
Do not imply courtyard access or a window jump where no opening has been established.
A223 uses a chosen reference-style fit-out; it is not a confirmed identity for photograph P022.

confirmed_campus_loop.via: Povo 1 entrance, external stairs, outdoor link, Povo 2 entrance
confirmed_campus_loop.geometry: reference terrain and solid massing only

unresolved: metric floor rises and complete step counts
vertical_model.policy: Keep prototype heights adjustable and labelled estimated. Do not treat phone GPS as an indoor survey, move the bridge to floor 1, or equate the two ground floors.

gameplay.first_step: Architectural traversal; retain the accepted outdoor arena as a working baseline.
gameplay.mode: Wingman remains the initial mode; no new bombsite or spawn layout is accepted by this design.
before_objective_placement: at least two approaches to the intended objective area

approved_game_adaptation.status: implemented first bridge and floor-1 arrival corridor
approved_game_adaptation.relocate_to: empty ground-floor corner of the corresponding size
approved_game_adaptation.note: A202/A203 relocated to the empty ground corner. User-authorized two-floor game adaptation; remaining Povo 2 interiors follow later.

current_implementation.connection: Povo 1 floor 1 to Povo 2 floor 1, via 30 m level bridge
current_implementation.note: Photo-confirmed route below remains historical reference. Current game adaptation intentionally uses two Povo 1 floors.
